newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Life holders approve split.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Life holders approve split.

text.p: The Manhattan Life Insurance Co said Tuesday its shareholders had approved a proposal to effect a 303,784-to-one reverse stock split of its guarantee capital shares, par value $2.00 per share.
As a result of the split, The Union Central Life Insurance Co will be the sole shareholder of Manhattan Life, it said.

The company said it intended to terminate the registration of its guarantee capital shares under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and remove its guarantee capital shares from quotation on the Nasdaq National Market System (NASDAQ).
"The company will become a private company with no public trading market for its guarantee capital shares," it said.
Union Central is an Ohio mutual life insurance company.

Manhattan said shareholders attending a January 28 special meeting approved the proposal, whereby each holder that surrenders 303,784 shares and contributes cash in the amount of $227,838 will receive in exchange one new guarantee capital share, par value $835,406 per share.

No fractional new guarantee capital shares will be issued for any resulting fractional new share interest, it said, explaining how shareholders who hold less than 303,784 guarantee capital shares will receive $7.50 for each guarantee capital share in lieu of receiving fractional new guarantee capital shares.
Manhattan Life is a guarantee capital life insurance company.
